items.prompt:
A generator converts
A) motion energy into electrical energy
B) light into sound
C) heat into light
D) sound into motion
items.answer: A) motion energy into electrical energy

steps: A generator turns motion into electricity.

items.prompt:
An electric motor converts
A) electrical energy into motion energy
B) light into heat
C) sound into light
D) motion into light
items.answer: A) electrical energy into motion energy

steps: A motor turns electricity into motion.

items.prompt:
A solar panel converts
A) light energy into electrical energy
B) sound into motion
C) heat into light
D) motion into sound
items.answer: A) light energy into electrical energy

steps: Solar panels convert light to electricity.

items.prompt:
A more efficient device converts
A) more of the input energy into useful output
B) less input into output
C) no energy
D) only sound
items.answer: A) more of the input energy into useful output

items.prompt:
An electric heater converts electrical energy into
A) thermal energy
B) light only
C) sound only
D) motion

steps: A heater turns electricity into heat.

items.prompt:
A hand-crank generator makes a dim light. To make it more efficient, you could
A) reduce friction or use a better bulb
B) add more friction
C) remove the bulb
D) crank slower only
items.answer: A) reduce friction or use a better bulb

items.prompt:
In a solar-powered motor, the energy path is
A) light to electricity to motion
B) motion to light to sound
C) heat to light to motion
D) sound to electricity to light
items.answer: A) light to electricity to motion

steps: Panel: light to electricity; motor: electricity to motion.

items.prompt:
Engineers test and refine energy-converting devices to
A) convert energy more efficiently
B) waste more energy
C) make them heavier
D) stop them working
